compiled_state.title: Reconciler unit suite: 2 pre-existing failures (test_e2e_dedup_pass zero-creates; test_fetcher_dedup_observable order-dependent)
compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
## Summary
Two pre-existing failures in tests/unit/dso_reconciler/ observed on clean origin/main (unrelated to any current change).

## Failures
1. test_e2e_dedup_pass.py::test_pre_existing_dso_id_produces_zero_creates — fails on clean main in isolation. FakeAcliClient lacks get_comments attribute (AttributeError) during inbound_create comment bootstrap; appears to produce a create instead of zero-creates.
2. test_fetcher_dedup_observable.py::test_dedup_suppression_emits_alert — ORDER-DEPENDENT: PASSES when run in isolation, FAILS in the full suite (expected a 'fetcher-dedup-suppressed' BRIDGE_ALERT, captured []). Likely shared-state / module-cache leakage between tests.

## Evidence
Full suite run 2026-06-05: 807 passed, 2 failed, 2 xfailed. Both failures reproduce on origin/main without local changes.

## Suggested fix
(1) Add get_comments to the FakeAcliClient stub or guard the bootstrap. (2) Investigate cross-test state leakage in the dedup-observable test (module-scoped fixtures / alert_store path isolation).

comments.body: See corrected diagnosis on a666-c442-bbdc-4aea (dedup cluster): NOT a test-harness/get_comments-stub gap — real cause is the missing inbound-create dedup guard in applier._apply_inbound_create (no mapping.json write, no dedup-create-skipped event). A production fix is required; semantics/perf decision pending. This ticket is a dedup candidate of that defect.
